mission.title: Resistance
mission.description: Search the Hampton area for the interface program's trail.

phase.briefing: {player}, Machines and Merovingian operatives have been confirmed in the Hampton area. Danielle Wright, and presumably the interface program, are still in the vicinity. It's going to be difficult, but we have to try getting through to the program. It has almost seemed to be trying to contact us...

enter.say: They were hoping we'd find the interface program's trail in there, but the big fat override signal I'm picking up there might just have shot that plan to hell.

done.say:
Crud! Well, that spot is a wash.
Hey, why weren't those Machinists getting slowed down by that override program?

phase.briefing:
We have been hearing about operatives apparently resisting override use, {player}, as well as rumors of a new type of accelerated program.
From the encounter you just had, it sounds like the Machines are intent on preventing us from locating the interface program. That wasn't unexpected, of course; we'll just have to do what we can.
I'm routing you to another area where override use has been detected. Look for any unusual activity that could be due to the interface program.

enter.say: Did you see that thing? I'm getting some weird readings. I guess it's overridden code, but it looks a little different than what we've seen before.
Whoa! What the hell are those?

done.say: I'd say we can confirm the new type of accelerated program Tyndall mentioned. I wonder what that Cypherite was doing there.

mission.finish:
Hm... We've had reports of something to do with Cypherites in Morrell. I wonder if it could be related to program overrides somehow.
{player}, I think we're making some progress in terms of understanding what's going on around Hampton, but we still need to find the interface program. Contact our operative in Hampton Green again when you're able.
